name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: An Operator Black loading skeleton using deterministic solid layers instead of gradient shimmer

variables.label: Lines
variables.description: Number of placeholder text lines beside the avatar. Values outside the range are clamped to it.

variables.label: Avatar
variables.description: Shape of the leading avatar block. None removes it and lets the lines fill the card.

variables.label: Sheen
variables.description: Strength of the highlight the timeline sweeps across each block.

variables.label: Width
variables.description: Maximum card width in pixels. The card still shrinks to fit a narrower container. Values outside the range are clamped to it.
